## About
K.O. Automotive began as a Volkswagen service shop in Mission Viejo and now works out of the El Toro Auto Center on Orange Avenue in Lake Forest. Today we take care of domestic, Asian and European vehicles for drivers around South Orange County.
Tony Padron owns the shop and runs it as General Manager, and Gabriel is our Service Manager. We keep track of your service milestones, talk through repairs in plain terms, and focus on what your car truly needs without pushing extra work.
We hold a 5 star Google rating from 37 reviews, and we'd be glad to have you stop by.

## Services
- Smog check and repairs: Our staff are certified to perform smog checks and the repairs that help a car pass.
- Oil changes and scheduled maintenance: We follow the schedule in your factory service guide, and each oil change includes an inspection of brakes, steering, suspension, fluids, hoses, belts, cooling system, drive train and tires.
- Domestic, Asian and European auto repair: From general maintenance to specific problems, we work on cars no matter where they were built.

## FAQ
Q: How often should I change my oil?
A: We recommend every 3,000 miles, or every 5,000 miles if you use synthetic oil.

Q: Can you use aftermarket parts to save money?
A: Yes. We recommend and use original parts, but we can use aftermarket parts if you prefer to save on costs.
